name: webcode/module-multisite-fpc
description: Makes multi-website Magento installations cacheable again for first-time visitors: scopes the HTTP context defaults (store, currency) to the current website, so non-default websites stop emitting X-Magento-Vary on every guest request and the official 2.4.6+ Varnish VCL cache-poisoning guard no longer marks every cookieless request hit-for-pass.
